name: SemanticHTMLERD
description: A secure single page web application (SPA) that generates semantic HTML entity-relationship diagrams (ERD) for SQL Server databases. Windows (Active Directory) and SQL Server logins are supported. SQL Server passwords are encrypted using Advanced Encryption Standard (AES). If no foreign keys are found in the user's database, the user may enter relationships manually and a T-SQL script of the foreign keys is generated for them. The front-end was developed using Angular while the back-end is a controller-based C# Application Programming Interface (API)
